verdict.rationale: The JMAP protocol that Fastmail's API is built on offers event subscription through EventSource push (one connection covering all mailboxes) and WebPush, which delivers change notifications without a permanent connection. That approximates webhook-style subscriptions, but these are protocol-level claims from jmap.io, not Fastmail-specific documentation of webhook endpoints. Missing for 10: Fastmail-specific confirmation that WebPush/push subscriptions are supported on its API, conventional configurable webhook endpoints with event-type filtering, delivery/retry/signing details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
